Ultra-premium studio product photograph of a single satin-white USB-A contactless hardware security key, floating in dark space. VIEW: three-quarter hero angle, device tilted about 30 degrees, flat USB-A blade with four gold contact pads pointing up and to the right, top face and near long edge both visible, molded keyring slot at lower-left. Preserve the EXACT object shown in the reference images — do not restyle, recolour, or change the geometry. Satin WHITE glass-filled-nylon body, a single brushed-brass NFC disc with a three-arc contactless wave centred on the face, one plain debossed stadium mark, flat USB-A blade with four exposed gold contact pads. Dramatic dark studio look: near-black background #0a0a0b, a soft deep-blue radial glow behind the key, a crisp electric-blue rim light tracing the top edge, a subtle soft reflection beneath. The product is floating — no surface, no desk, no props, no laptop. Razor-sharp focus edge to edge, hero product shot, generous even margins around the key. | X | body slab only (excl. connector blade) | **≈ 33.0 mm** |

| Z | USB-A blade thickness | **≈ 2.0 mm** |
| — | mass (archetype) | ≈ 3 g |

thickness. Mirror-symmetric about the X–Z plane; NFC disc and blade centered on Y.
